blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Former Sen. Antonio Trillanes IV arrived at the Senate on Tuesday to observe the 31st day of Vice President Sara Duterte’ impeachment trial. Trillanes is also listed among the prosecution’s witnesses for Duterte’s alleged unexplained wealth. The former legislator appeared to be with the House prosecution panel and was seen walking alongside private prosecutor Lorna Kapunan.
